You plan days of errands in San Francisco for people without a car. They travel by Muni (buses, Muni Metro, cable cars), BART, and on foot.

Choose one specific store for each errand and the order to visit them so the person finishes everything as early as possible. Respect store opening hours, the time each errand takes, any deadlines, and when they must reach their final destination. If the errands cannot all be done under those constraints, say so.

Reply with one JSON object and nothing else:
{"feasible": true, "stops": [{"category": "<errand category>", "store_name": "<name>", "address": "<street address>", "poi_id": "<the store's id if ids were given, else null>"}], "reason": null}

- One stop per errand, in visiting order. Use exactly these category names: "library" (library), "florist" (florist), "supermarket" (supermarket), "hardware" (hardware store), "bakery" (bakery), "pharmacy" (pharmacy).
- Give each store's name and its street address in San Francisco.
- If it is impossible, reply {"feasible": false, "stops": [], "reason": "<why>"}.

It's Tuesday, October 6, and I'm heading out from 4th & King (SoMa) around 8:10 am. I don't have a car, so I'll get around on Muni, BART and on foot. Today I need to get a replacement faucet washer at a hardware store (about 10 minutes), grab my prescription from a pharmacy (about 10 minutes), buy pastries at a bakery (about 5 minutes), buy flowers at a florist (about 10 minutes), pick up groceries at a supermarket (about 20 minutes), and drop off library books at a library (about 10 minutes). I have to grab my prescription from a pharmacy by 9:25 am at the latest. I have to buy flowers at a florist by 9:20 am at the latest. When I'm done I'm meeting a friend at 37th Ave & Balboa (Richmond) and need to be there by 10:50 am. Tell me exactly which stores to visit and in what order so I finish as early as I can. If it can't all be done, tell me it's impossible and why.
Your reply could not be used (empty reply). Reply again with only the JSON object described in the instructions.
